bid.welcome:
Hi! I am an auction bot. You can bid in the channel.

Commands:
/menu - User menu (won, active, watchlist)
/my - My active auctions
/won - My won auctions
/about - About the bot
bid.about_text: 🎯 Retro Auction Bot — smart auctions inside Telegram Version: v{{version}} Turn regular channel posts into fully interactive auctions with bidding buttons, real-time updates, and automatic winner selection. ⚡ Features: • One-tap bidding with confirmation • Anti-sniping (auto time extension) • Real-time notifications (outbid / win) • Rich media preview (photo + full description) • /my and /won commands for user tracking • Custom currency, language, and templates • Ukrainian & English support • AI-generated auction titles and descriptions 🛠 Admin tools: • Step-by-step auction creation wizard • Direct posting to channel • Advanced admin panel & settings • Restart or instantly finish auctions 🔗 GitHub: https://github.com/antoxa2584x/retro_auction_bot 🚀 Perfect for Telegram channels that want fast, clean, and automated auction workflows.
